% Shared Tikz Preamble for Diagram Atomization Pipeline
% Load this in every tikz generated by Phase 5 subagents.
% Do NOT redefine these — use exactly this preamble.

\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}

% Core libraries
\usetikzlibrary{
    arrows.meta,       % arrow styles
    positioning,       % relative placement
    cd,                % commutative diagrams (tikz-cd)
    calc,              % coordinate calculations
    shapes.geometric,  % ellipses, polygons, etc.
    shapes.misc,       % rounded rectangles, etc.
    decorations.markings,  % arrow on paths
    backgrounds,       % background layer
    fit,               % fitting nodes around others
}

% Standard arrow tip
\tikzset{>=Stealth}

% Commutative diagram style
\tikzcdset{
    arrows={>=Stealth},
    row sep/normal=3em,
    column sep/normal=4em,
}

% Common node styles
\tikzset{
    mathnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, inner sep=2pt},
    labelnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, font=\small, inner sep=1pt},
}

\begin{document}
%
% P(1,1,2) Triangle Lattice Polytope
% Moment polytope of the weighted projective space P(1,1,2)
% Vertex coordinates: v0=(0,0), v1=(2,0), v2=(0,1)
%
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=3.5]
    % --- Shaded interior ---
    \fill[fill=lightgray!50] (0,0) -- (2,0) -- (0,1) -- cycle;

    % --- Edges (solid black) ---
    \draw[thick] (0,0) -- node[below, near start, sloped] {} (2,0);
    \draw[thick] (0,0) -- (0,1);
    \draw[thick] (0,1) -- (2,0);

    % --- Vertices (solid black dots) ---
    \filldraw[black] (0,0) circle (2.5pt);  % v0
    \filldraw[black] (2,0) circle (2.5pt);  % v1
    \filldraw[black] (0,1) circle (2.5pt);  % v2

    % --- Interior lattice point on bottom edge (unlabeled in diagram) ---
    \filldraw[black] (1,0) circle (2.5pt);

    % --- Vertex labels ---
    \node[labelnode, below left=1pt] at (0,0) {\small$v_0$};
    \node[labelnode, below right=1pt] at (2,0) {\small$v_1$};
    \node[labelnode, above left=1pt] at (0,1) {\small$v_2$};

    % --- Polytope label P (near center of hypotenuse) ---
    \node[labelnode, above right, rotate=-26.565] at (1,0.5) {\small$P$};

\end{tikzpicture}
%
\end{document}
